summary: Iteration 12 (MJD Kupi Batch A) backend validation. New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_dashboard_tax.py — 9 tests covering server-authoritative tax_config (OFF default: tax=0 total==subtotal even when client sends tax=999; ON 11%: tax=round(subtotal*0.11), client-sent tax=0 IGNORED and overridden; GET /api/settings/tax_config round-trip), Dashboard analytics (daily mode → 7 trend items with label/gross/count, hourly mode → 24 items labeled 00:00..23:00, outlet_id=all → outlet_scope='all' and outlet_compare non-empty, outlet_id=outlet-kemang → outlet_scope='outlet-kemang' and outlet_compare==[], Kasir role ignores outlet_id param and is scoped to own outlet), and Dashboard basic (outlet_id=all → keys sales_total/expense_total/transaction_count/net_profit/outlet_scope='all'). ALL 9/9 PASSED. Regression: iter11 15/15 + iter10 25/25 = 40/40 PASSED sequentially (-n 0). tax_config restored to {enabled:false, percent:10} via module autouse fixture at suite end.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated / any role can read tax_config (no auth dependency). POST is properly gated to Super Admin/Admin. Low risk (public tax rate) but inconsistent — consider requiring auth on GET too.

Naming misleading: variable is called `week_expense` but the query has no date filter — it sums ALL expenses ever for the scope, then is exposed as kpi.expenses_total and used in net_profit. Either add >=last_week_start filter or rename. Current test doesn't assert value so passes.

When user is Kasir/Vendor scope is forced to their outlet — good; but low_stock query filters by Product.outlet_id which is stable. Products that have no outlet_id will be excluded even in scope=all. Verify seed data has outlet_id set on all products.

action_items: Consider adding auth requirement on GET /api/settings/{key} for consistency (low priority).
Fix or rename kpi.expenses_total in /api/dashboard/analytics — it sums ALL time expenses, not week/period (analytics label suggests time-bounded).
The tax bypass loophole noted in iter11 is now CLOSED for tax=0 override — server always recomputes from tax_config. Good progress on SEC-005.
critical_code_review_comments: tax_config is now truly server-authoritative — SaleInput.tax field is completely ignored by create_sale (line 870-874). Recommend removing `tax` from SaleInput schema or documenting it as informational-only to prevent client confusion.

dashboard_analytics runs many separate awaits in loops (24 hourly slots = 48 SQL round-trips; 7 daily slots = 14 round-trips; per-outlet compare adds 2×N more). This is O(N) latency with the DB. Consider a single GROUP BY date_trunc/hour query. Currently ~1-3s but will degrade with scale.

base_where() closure captures `scope` from enclosing function — fine, but week_expense stmt does NOT use base_where and has ternary select() that skips the outlet filter entirely when scope is None (correct) — however it never filters by time. Bug: kpi.expenses_total is unbounded time.
server.py is now 1959 lines (was 1813 in iter11). Still well over the 700-line guideline — split routers/{dashboard,sales,settings}.py.
outlet_compare loop issues 2 queries per outlet (N outlets → 2N queries). Merge into a single GROUP BY outlet_id query.
GET /api/settings/{key} returns {} for missing keys instead of 404. Downstream frontend must distinguish 'never set' from 'empty object'. Consider returning null or 404.
seed_data_creation: tax_config setting created and RESTORED to {enabled:false, percent:10} at suite end via autouse fixture. A few TEST_ prefixed sales added under kasir (Meja TAX_OFF, Meja TAX_ON) — do not affect analytics counts materially.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter12 alone (works with xdist -n auto — no shift race). For full regression run iter10+iter11+iter12 sequentially (-n 0) due to known iter10 TestShiftLock/TestCashOpname xdist race on shared kasir user. tax_config is server-authoritative now: any test that POSTs /api/sales with client-tax expectations must set tax_config first and always reset to {enabled:false, percent:10} at end. The autouse fixture in test_iteration12 handles reset. Kasir outlet is 'outlet-sudirman' by default.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Server-side tax enforcement + dashboard analytics all behaving per spec.
